name: Utsuro
source:
There isn't anybody in the hive that doesn't know of the Bug Caretaker, Utsuro. Most bees don't want anything to do with him due to him carrying around the various bugs he takes care of, in addition to his odd, servile smile. When Kaguya speaks to him kindly, he comes to greatly admire her.

[Based on the tanslation of the official website profile.]
translation:
There isn't anybody in the hive that doesn't know of the Bug Caretaker, Utsuro. Most bees don't want anything to do with him due to him carrying around the various bugs he takes care of, in addition to his odd, servile smile. When Kaguya speaks to him kindly, he comes to greatly admire her.

[Based on the tanslation of the official website profile.]
